runtime_prompt_en:
Image 1 is the sole identity and adult-age reference.

Create a photorealistic Republic of Korea Armed Forces promotional poster featuring the same unmistakably adult woman from the reference portrait as a modern special-warfare operator. Preserve her eye aperture and spacing, long oval face, jaw width, nose, lips, natural skin texture, adult age, and long dark wavy hair. She powers forward through a rain-wet obstacle course, one boot striking a shallow puddle into a sharp arc of spray as her torso leans into the stride toward the next concrete ramp. Her matte helmet, headset, uniform, plate carrier, and pouches move with believable weight; a compact carbine stays controlled across her chest, muzzle angled down. A low 35 mm three-quarter full-body frame uses a boot-to-face diagonal, keeping her identity dominant while the upper sky remains a clean field reserved for later typography. The same sunrise rim light catches her cheek, helmet, spray, and wet armor; rain darkens nylon seams and beads across matte surfaces. Her focused gaze reaches beyond the camera toward the objective. The result reads as premium national-defense recruitment campaign key art: energetic, disciplined, capable, and resolutely forward-moving.

Avoid: broken window geometry, warped walls, over-processed retouching, unrealistic hands, broken facial features, illustration look, low resolution, 3D render look, impossible perspective
